items.title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
items.summary: Open source models are becoming more mainstream as enterprises, governments and startups alike rely on the promise of lower costs, more control, and more flexibility. But as increasingly capable models become more freely available, how do companies capture value? And with Chinese open models gaining ground, can American players keep up?  On this episode of […]
items.creator: Theresa Loconsolo

items.title: DuckDuckGo pitches itself to schools amid backlash over Google’s AI policy
items.summary: DuckDuckGo is courting schools frustrated by Google's AI restrictions, pointing educators to its search engine and options to disable AI features.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: Waymo confirms it will start splitting with Uber in January 2028
items.summary: The split will set up direct competition in those markets, as Uber has many other autonomous vehicle partners on its network.
items.creator: Sean O'Kane
